subject: Request: 30/60/90 remediation calendar + verifier checklist
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finsight.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finsight.com
Date: 2027-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 30/60/90 remediation calendar and verifier checklist

Hi Jasmine,

As part of our SIG intake and upcoming SOC 2 review, FinSight needs a concise remediation calendar that shows how Redwood will handle newly identified critical and high CVEs over 30/60/90 day horizons. Specifically we need: 

- A committed SLO for time-to-remediate (or mitigation) for Critical / High severity CVEs.
- Ownership (team/role) for triage → fix → verify steps.
- An example 30/60/90 calendar for a hypothetical Critical CVE including verification steps and evidence pointers.
- A short verifier checklist (items an auditor can tick off) and links to artifacts (scan reports, patch logs, Jira tickets).

I attached a small matrix with the fields we expect (finsight_request_matrix.csv). Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to a 30-day remediation target for Critical CVEs that affect customer-facing inference endpoints, and if not, what compensating controls or escrow you propose?

Would appreciate an initial response by EOD tomorrow; if useful we can schedule a quick 30-minute walkthrough.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Senior Security Manager, FinSight

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finsight.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-29T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 30/60/90 remediation calendar and verifier checklist

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear matrix. Attaching a short plan (redwood_30-60-90_plan.xlsx) and a one-page proof index (proof_links.md) with direct links to our scan and ticketing artifacts. High level answer up front:

- For Critical CVEs that impact customer-facing inference (model serving/runtime), Redwood commits to an initial mitigation or rollback within 72 hours of validation and to ship a full remediation within 30 days when a safe patch or config change is available.
- For High CVEs, target remediation is 60 days, with triage/mitigation within 7 days.
- Our ownership: Security Triage (kimberly_park) → Infra/Routing (mateo_alvarez) → Serving Engineers (on-call owner) for patch/deploy. The attached plan maps responsibilities to Jira workflows.

Key compensating controls when immediate patching is risky:
- Temporary traffic routing to isolated capacity pools (canary + degraded model variant).
- Runtime WAF rules or inference-layer input sanitization where applicable.
- Short-lived configuration disablement for vulnerable subsystems.

I've included a compact 30/60/90 example (row in the spreadsheet) using a hypothetical CVE in our tokenizer lib to show evidence items auditors will see: nightly scan snapshot, ticket ID, fix commit, canary rollout notes, and successful post-deploy vulnerability scan.

Next steps:
1) Can we book a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow 11:00–11:30 PT?
2) If you want a signer-friendly artifact set we can prepare a minimal DocuSign cover and an auditor-facing checklist.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-29T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 30/60/90 remediation calendar and verifier checklist

Jasmine — quick clarifying note to include in the verifier checklist above (pasting into the draft):

On Wed, Sep 29, 2027 at 10:08 AM jasmine_liu@redwood.ai wrote:
> - For Critical CVEs that impact customer-facing inference (model serving/runtime), Redwood commits to an initial mitigation or rollback within 72 hours of validation and to ship a full remediation within 30 days when a safe patch or config change is available.

Add the following verification items auditors often request: 
- Scan provenance: scanner name/version + scan timestamp (we push these into nightly artifacts).
- Triage record: a Jira ticket with triage label + assigned owner and severity tag (SEC- or SERV- prefixed).
- Mitigation evidence: canary rollout notes + traffic-shift logs showing % reduction to affected pools.
- Patch proof: commit hash + release note + post-patch scan (pass/fail).

I'll assemble the checklist and the example ticket flow by EOD and link to SEC-1147 (the sandbox ticket we referenced).

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Vulnerability Triage, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@finsight.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finsight.com
Date: 2027-09-30T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 30/60/90 remediation calendar and verifier checklist

Thanks, Jasmine and Kimberly — this is exactly what we needed. The 72-hour initial mitigation + 30-day remediation for Critical CVEs is acceptable provided we receive the auditor-facing checklist and the proof links ahead of our SOC 2 kick-off next week.

Let's do the walkthrough — 11:00 PT tomorrow works. Please include your on-call infra lead (Mateo) so we can ask a couple of operational questions about traffic routing. Also please send the DocuSign cover if you prepare it so procurement can pre-approve.

Emily
Emily Zhang
Senior Security Manager, FinSight
